svg.title: Red Curve IV
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. White triangular support retained below/right of the red arc. Upper-left white is surrounding wall, consistent with museum description of a demi-carré blanc; omitted.
